Install Instructions:

1. Download the files manually it won't work if ya use stardrop or any other mod installer like mod organizer

2. (optional) Back up the original portrait files! if you're worried about the files being loaded but don't wanna lose em in the sea of your computer i'd personally Label the folder as ._Original Portraits so that it tells the game not to load those files in!

3. unzip the files and have it replace the files where deepwoods mod is located then click accept when it asks ya to replace the files
